text: Once upon a time, a small duck found a shiny red ball in the garden.
The duck played with the ball every day and was very happy.
One day the ball rolled away and the duck ran after it.
The ball stopped near the pond and the duck pushed it into the water.
The ball floated on the water and the duck swam beside it all afternoon.
A little girl named Lily saw the duck and laughed at the game.
Lily helped the duck push the ball back to the garden.
The duck and Lily shared the red ball and became best friends.
Every morning the duck waited for Lily by the garden fence.
They played with the red ball until the sun went down.
The duck slept happily knowing tomorrow would be another fun day.
And so the small duck, the kind girl, and the shiny red ball lived happily together.
